title: Add Parallel Responses adapter as a native grounding family
description: Parallel's Responses API (docs.parallel.ai/responses-api) is OpenAI-compatible with citations, priced by reasoning effort at $10 (low) / $50 (medium) / $250 (high) per 1K requests, 5s-60s latency. It could ride the existing native grounding infrastructure: executeGroundedSearch in src/grounding.ts + one NATIVE_REGISTRY row in src/router.ts + capabilities/build/normalize + offline fixtures, same shape as Meta (which reuses the OpenAI-shaped normalizer). It would add Parallel-synthesized grounded answers alongside evidence. Open questions to resolve before starting: (1) routing/billing policy — metered per reasoning effort, so it must be explicit-hint only or behind a policy flag like the Exa/Brave gates, never automatic; (2) which reasoning-effort tier maps from our contracts (answerMode? a new option?) — the extension has no effort control today; (3) credential mechanism — PARALLEL_API_KEY works for the x-api-key header per docs.parallel.ai, but confirm the Responses endpoint accepts it; (4) live contract smoke with the existing key per docs/live-smoke.md once implemented. User direction 2026-09-06: not wanted now; task exists so the option is tracked. Quality posture evidence in docs/provider-policy.md (2026-09 section): Parallel advanced ranks #1 of 12 on the independent Artificial Analysis Search Index (Aug 2026).

logs.msg: Created from 2026-09-06 provider round: user declined implementation now, wants the option tracked. Do not start without explicit user direction; resolve the four open questions first.

Declined 2026-09-06: provider-synthesized answers are redundant for this extension. The calling agent already has cheap evidence search (native grounding + Exa/Brave/Parallel) plus web_fetch, and can synthesize its own answers from inspectable evidence at model cost. Parallel Responses is metered per reasoning effort (0-250/1K) for output the agent produces better from raw evidence. Task closed as declined; do not reopen without a workflow that genuinely needs provider-side synthesis.
